breadcrumb: Std 6 Science Term-II (English) — Unit 3: Changes Around Us — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: A change is the observable difference between initial state and the final state of any substance.

options: the difference between initial and final states
the total weight of a substance
a fixed state of a substance
a type of force acting on a substance
en.explanation: A change is any observable difference between a substance's initial and final states.

ta.explanation: ஒரு பொருளின் தொடக்க, இறுதி நிலைகளுக்கு இடையே காணக்கூடிய வேறுபாடே மாற்றம்.

questions.quote: Reversible changes: Touch me not plant (responding to touch), stretching of rubber band, melting of ice.

en.q: Which of the following is a reversible change?
en.explanation: Irreversible: change of milk into curd, digestion of food, making idli from batter.

ta.explanation: பால் தயிராதல், உணவு செரித்தல், மாவு இட்லியாதல் மீளா மாற்றங்கள்.

questions.quote: Slow changes: growth of nail and hair, change of seasons, germination of seed. Fast changes: bursting of balloon, breaking of glass, bursting of fire crackers, burning of paper.

en.q: Changes Around Us: Which of the following is a fast change?
en.explanation: Fast changes take place within seconds or minutes.

questions.quote: The change of state from solid to gas directly is called sublimation. Example: Camphor

en.q: The change of state from solid directly to gas is called ______.

ta.q: திண்மம் நேரடியாக வாயுவாக மாறும் நிலை மாற்றம் ______ எனப்படும்.

questions.quote: Change of state: ice into water on heating - melting; water into steam on heating - vapourisation; steam into water on cooling - condensation; water into ice on cooling - freezing.

en.q: The change of steam into water on cooling is called ______.
en.explanation: When steam cools it turns back into water; this is condensation.

questions.quote: Physical changes: Melting of ice, the solution of salt or sugar, stretching of rubber band.

en.q: Changes Around Us: Which of the following is a physical change?
en.explanation: Burning of wood, popping of popcorn, blackening of silver and rusting of iron are chemical changes.

ta.explanation: மரம் எரிதல், சோளம் பொரிதல், வெள்ளி கருமையாதல், துருப்பிடித்தல் வேதியியல் மாற்றங்கள்.

questions.quote: The spreading of the solid particles among the liquid molecules is called as dissolution.

en.q: The spreading of solid particles among the liquid molecules is called ______.
en.explanation: Solvent dissolves the solute; the solute dissolves in the solvent to make a solution.

ta.q: திடத் துகள்கள் நீர்ம மூலக்கூறுகளிடையே பரவுவது ______ எனப்படும்.

questions.quote: Water is known as the universal solvent. It dissolves a wide range of substance.

en.q: Water is called the ______ because it dissolves a wide range of substances.

ta.explanation: நீர் பல பொருள்களைக் கரைக்கும். (மேலும்: அனைத்துக் கரைப்பான்.)

questions.quote: Chemical changes are the permanent changes in which there is a change in the chemical composition and new substance is formed. Examples: Burning of wood, Popping of popcorn, Blackening of silver ornaments, Rusting of iron.

en.explanation: Chemical changes are permanent and irreversible.

questions.quote: Leave the other half of the cut apple on the table for some time. Brown patches formed due to the reaction between some substances in the apple and the air around it. This is a chemical change.

en.q: Brown patches on a cut apple left in air are due to a ______.
en.explanation: Cutting the apple alone is a physical change.

ta.q: வெட்டிய ஆப்பிளைக் காற்றில் வைத்தால் பழுப்புப் புள்ளிகள் தோன்றுவது ஒரு ______.

questions.quote: Physical change: temporary, reversible. Chemical change: permanent, irreversible.

en.explanation: A physical change is temporary and reversible.
